question: What is the maximum number of players that can be on the field during a football match in team?
solution:
The correct answer is **__11.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A match is played by two teams, each with a maximum of **eleven players. **
 
• **One must be the goalkeeper.**
 
• A match may not start or continue if either team has fewer than seven players.
 
• Each of the two competing teams can have a maximum of **11 players** on the field at any time.
 
• Playing with more on the field is punishable by a penalty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lacrosse has a number of 12 Players in a team.
 
• Kho Kho has a number of 09 Players in a team.
